intro: Hearty food made for cold winters and beer halls: sausages, pork, potatoes, cabbage, dark bread and mustard.
flavours: Pork, potatoes, cabbage, mustard, caraway, rye
hk: Oktoberfest season fills Hong Kong's German bierhauses every autumn.

dishes.name: Bratwurst
dishes.what: Grilled pork sausage, eaten in a roll with mustard; Nuremberg's are finger-sized.

dishes.name: Currywurst
dishes.what: Berlin street food: sliced sausage drowned in curry-spiced ketchup, with fries.

dishes.name: Schweinshaxe
dishes.what: Bavarian roasted pork knuckle with crackling skin, served with dumplings or sauerkraut.

dishes.name: Schnitzel
dishes.what: Meat pounded thin, breaded and fried golden. (Veal Wiener Schnitzel is the Austrian original.)

dishes.name: Sauerbraten
dishes.what: Sliced pot roast in a tangy sweet-sour gravy (the beef is marinated in vinegar for days).

dishes.name: Pretzel
dishes.what: Knotted bread with a dark, glossy crust and coarse salt; a beer-hall essential.

dishes.name: Spätzle
dishes.what: Soft little egg noodles from Swabia; with melted cheese and fried onions it's Käsespätzle.

dishes.name: Black Forest cake
dishes.what: Chocolate sponge layered with whipped cream, cherries and cherry brandy.
